title: New econ unit test passes vacuously when catalogs fail to load (silent return instead of fail_now)
detail: A bare return from an @(test) is a PASS in core:testing, so a catalog-load failure makes this anti-vacuity gate ship green — the exact W3/W5 class the commit claims to close; the sibling a11y oracle uses testing.fail_now.
recommended_fix: Replace the print+return with testing.fail_now(t, "econ unit cannot load the catalogs: ...") so a broken catalog fails the row.
